_comment: THE PICTURE SHELF (render/shelf.js). Symbol pictures for stories no photograph can show.
Every entry is a Wikimedia Commons file. 'approved' is Stefan's tick and nothing else may set it.
'checkedOn' is the day a person last opened the file page and confirmed licence, author and content; older than a year = not used.
'concepts' is the closed list. The script's weekly naming call (Carousel.gs) must use exactly these words; a word not on this list is no picture.
Rules for a picture to be on the shelf at all: public domain, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA; no recognisable face; no brand or logo; it shows the concept plainly.
